title: GoOrganicAfrica readiness batch 09 - Liberia and The Gambia administrative geography
scope: Current first-level administrative geography verification only. No country is certified calculator-ready.

countries.name: Liberia

calculator_readiness.crop_area_production_yield: LAAS 2024 tables require careful re-extraction; area/yield denominators and numbering discrepancies remain
calculator_readiness.farmgate_prices: dated county-level farmgate prices and units pending
calculator_readiness.input_costs: seed, fertilizer, crop protection, irrigation, labour and machinery costs pending
calculator_readiness.currency: LRD; confirm all source price units, currency and dates
calculator_readiness.tests: county/crop mapping, calculation, currency and localization tests pending

safeguards: Do not confuse county-level lookup with district/clan geography.
Do not use LAAS table values until internal numbering and yield-denominator discrepancies are reconciled.
Do not activate until crop data, dated prices, input costs, budgets and tests are validated.

countries.name: The Gambia

calculator_readiness.crop_area_production_yield: 2025 NASC collection and crop-area/output denominator verification pending
calculator_readiness.farmgate_prices: dated regional farmgate prices and units pending
calculator_readiness.input_costs: seed, fertilizer, crop protection, irrigation, labour and machinery costs pending
calculator_readiness.currency: GMD; confirm source price denomination, unit and date
calculator_readiness.tests: region/crop mapping, calculation, currency and localization tests pending

safeguards: Banjul City Council and Kanifing Municipal Council are not included as regions.
Do not treat historical MacCarthy Island or Western Region names as separate current regions.
Do not activate until crop data, dated prices, input costs, budgets and tests are validated.

summary: Liberia's 15 counties and The Gambia's five administrative regions are recorded. The Gambia's Banjul and Kanifing local-government areas are kept distinct from the five regions.
